title: Chalmers: Higher Bond Yields Will Pressure Australia Budget
description: Jim Chalmers, Australian Treasurer, says higher global bond yields will put pressure on the Australian budget as the widespread selloff pushes debt refinancing costs higher. He speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Shery Ahn on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Banks Chase Risky Chip Loans in Asia’s $8.2 Trillion AI Buildout
description: The next wave of artificial intelligence debt financing is taking off in Asia.

title: Oracle 2025 Health Breach Compromised Data of 20 Million People
description: A cybersecurity breach last year of Oracle Corp.’s healthcare unit compromised personal information belonging to nearly 20 million people, according to information released by the Texas attorney general.
